response: The factors determining the survival of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) with lung metastasis alone include age, disease-free interval (DFI), and the use of combined modality treatment. Specifically, patients with age ≤ 45 years, DFI > 1 year, and those who receive combined therapy tend to have better prognostic outcomes. The combination of local therapy and basic chemotherapy is recommended for patients with DFI > 1 year. This suggests that combined modality treatment can benefit patients with NPC and lung metastasis alone, particularly those with a longer disease-free interval.
